Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
